name: notification-platform
description: Production-style multi-channel Notification Platform (Postgres source of truth + BullMQ + Kafka + Outbox)

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @notification/shared-types && npm run build -w @notification/shared-utils && npm run build -w @notification/database
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules apps/*/node_modules packages/*/node_modules apps/*/dist packages/*/dist
